notes:
- Feature: real licenses. Keys are checked against the license server (license-server/: Cloudflare Worker + D1, deployed at https://qx-license.powerledger-data.workers.dev) instead of the old DEV mode that accepted any well-shaped key. The seller's admin portal (same address) generates keys of 1, 7, 30, 90 days, lifetime or custom (the clock starts at first use), limits devices per key (1 by default), and revokes, restores, extends, resets devices, deletes unused keys and exports a CSV; every admin action is in an activity log.
- The extension re-checks the key every hour, so a revoked or expired key stops working within the hour (auto-trade switches off); if the server cannot be reached, a key that was valid keeps working for 24 hours. The panel shows the plan, days left and expiry date. A device id is created when missing.
- Old DEV keys no longer work: users need a real key from the seller.
